text: Isaac carries the wood. He asks about the lamb, and receives an answer which settles nothing; of his inward thought the writer tells us nothing, and gives only a verb, that they went, both of them, together. The phrase recurs, as if repetition could stand in for explanation. The question of consent is raised, and then quietly set down; the writer leaves us at the end with the same words, they went, both of them, together.
